set.body: Specify and implement a minimal composition bridge from NeuroArchive-backed storage to FmriDataset. Reuse DatasetError, DataSelection, DatasetIndex, DatasetRunQuery, DatasetMetadata, and DatasetRunPartition. Add only source composers, provenance as a metadata value, checked indexed run views, coordinate/window selection extensions, and segmented group/concatenate/reduce operations. Preserve explicit LNA timing/run selection, derived Zarr timing, module-graph honesty, and JVM/JS verification.
